checks.scope: First independent mathematical, physical, source-fidelity and cultural review of the frozen REPAIR-1 candidate only. Not promotion, review@1 generation, offline acceptance or product acceptance.

currentWholeProse.bodyJoinRule: CURRENT lesson.template.prose entries with kind=p, joined in order with two newline characters; captions remain separate.

independentSourceInventory.basis: Recomputed by opening the actual original PNG at its original resolution, before opening any candidate preview. Neither producer observations nor object counts establish source fidelity.

groups.observation: One continuous horizontal suspended strip with five hanging two-leaf foil positions. All five pairs have visibly comparable, nonzero openings.
groups.relationshipEvidence: strip-span; foil-i-on-strip, left/right-vector, equal-leaves, length and tip-span for i=1..5; foil-i-left/right-same-angle for i=2..5.

groups.observation: Two complete supports, each with a ball top, upright, broad foot and diagonal end member. The left strip end has no coiled electrical lead to earth; the physical support foot is not an earth symbol.
groups.relationshipEvidence: Both post/brace connects assertions, ball contact/radius and height/foot-span assertions resolve. No strip-earth objects are present.

groups.observation: A coiled lead leaves the right strip end, rises over the right support and reaches the generator's left terminal. A separate coiled lead leaves the right generator terminal and ends at one descending three-bar earth symbol.
groups.relationshipEvidence: Every lead segment has a mapped connects assertion. Independent endpoint and continuity checks reach the actual strip/terminal coordinates and earth stem; three horizontal earth bars decrease in width.

groups.observation: A physical electrostatic generator, not a battery symbol: large radially segmented disk/rim and hub, diagonal contact member, two separate electrode assemblies, two vertical jar-like side assemblies, lower wheel/rings and hub, drive members, crank and broad platform.
groups.relationshipEvidence: Disk/hub/wheel dimensions, terminal separation and platform width are asserted; electrode arms, rods, frame, neutralizer, drive members and crank have mapped connects assertions. All these parts are visible in the final previews.

independentSourceInventory.modernAdditions: English identification labels and clean apparatus geometry; exact 44-degree foil openings, equal 42-unit leaf lengths, regular spacing, 16 regular disk sectors and clean three-bar grounds are modern regularization, not printed source measurements. Occlusion and scan ink do not justify claiming an exact source sector count.

mathematicalAndSemanticMappings.method: Independent read-only coordinate arithmetic, reference resolution, source-inventory mapping and lead-chain checks. No native validator or renderer executed.
mathematicalAndSemanticMappings.parallelCheck: Eight same-angle assertions separately checked by cross products; absolute residual at most 5.685e-13. Their initial omission from the arithmetic switch was a check-coverage gap, not a candidate defect.

physicalAndPolarityInterpretation.observation: The right electrode is earthed; the other electrode charges the wet strip while its left end has no earth return. Five equal open pairs are consistent with the complete prose's settled open-circuit/equipotential case, not sustained current along the strip.

savedNativeEvidence.role: Hash-checked saved producer evidence, supplemented by the independent actual image inspections below; not re-executed.

actualImageReview.usability: At all three actual widths the continuous strip and all five equal foil pairs remain distinguishable. Both complete supports, both separate terminal assemblies, strip lead, generator earth lead and three earth bars are visible. Disk sectors, lower wheel/hub, drive links, crank and platform remain identifiable even at 331 pixels.
actualImageReview.sourceFidelity: Instructional apparatus and relationships are retained with clean line-art simplification; no disconnected schematic substitution, polarity annotation, answer annotation, cultural wording or scan texture.
